benchmarks.name: AI Lawyer (ailawyer.pro)
weaknesses: No full law firm case management suite
benchmarks.legallyAiParity: SUPERIOR: LegallyAI offers 10+ dedicated hubs, full practice management, and ad-supported free tier with mascot Lee.

benchmarks.name: Thomson Reuters CoCounsel (Casetext)
weaknesses: Exorbitantly priced for consumers and solo lawyers
benchmarks.legallyAiParity: SUPERIOR ACCESSIBILITY: LegallyAI provides Perplexity-style statutory citations and plain-English answers for everyday people at 1/10th the cost.

benchmarks.name: Spellbook
weaknesses: Contract only; no litigation, custody, DUI, or consumer defense features
benchmarks.legallyAiParity: CROSS-DISCIPLINE: LegallyAI combines contract redlining with family law, criminal defense, traffic defense, and estate planning.

benchmarks.name: EvenUp
weaknesses: Strictly personal injury; no consumer-facing assistant
benchmarks.legallyAiParity: INCLUDED: LegallyAI has built-in damages & settlement estimation and demand drafting.

recommendations: Highlight Perplexity-style statutory citation preview chips in chat
Feature Lee mascot as the proactive legal guide across all hubs
Provide instant contract redline & risk assessment studio on web & mobile
Integrate damages and settlement estimation calculator
